intro:
The professionals at Petro Land Ventures have worked land projects across multiple states and basins — from the prolific plays of East Texas and Louisiana's emerging shale formations to Appalachian Basin development and the growing renewable energy sector. The common thread: careful, thorough land work carried out by people who know the territory and the stakeholders.

Projects have ranged from single-tract curative work to multi-county leasing programs, A&D packages, and complex portfolio due diligence. The experience is broad, and the standards are consistent.
